claim: 44% of Indonesians regularly pay attention to creators or influencers on social and video networks -- third-highest of 24 countries surveyed -- against 25% for news brands or journalists, one of the widest creator-over-institution gaps measured anywhere.
stance_target: The claim that Southeast Asian audience demand for creator content is among the highest in the world, so low measured creator income there cannot be explained by weak demand
scope_conditions: Indonesia; Reuters Institute Digital News Report 2024 and 2025 surveys, published 28 October 2025; measures news-context attention among social-media news users, so it understates total creator attention; audience-side measurement only
quoted_support: Proportion that regularly pay attention to creators/influencers in social and video networks 44% (3/24) ... Proportion that regularly pay attention to news brands/journalists in social and video networks 25% (15/24)
entities: Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism

claim: 12 of the top 15 most-named Indonesian creators and news influencers are men, a measured gender concentration at the top of the Indonesian attention distribution.
stance_target: The claim that creator attention and therefore creator income concentrates along demographic lines, so aggregate creator statistics conceal systematic distributional inequality
scope_conditions: Indonesia; derived from open-text respondent naming in the 2024-2025 Digital News Report, cleaned with OpenRefine and cross-checked with an LLM recode; the institute cautions rank order is indicative not definitive; news-context naming only
quoted_support: Gender balance 12 of the top 15 individuals are men
entities: Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism

claim: The top of the Indonesian creator distribution reaches audiences of tens of millions -- Willie Salim over 70m TikTok followers, Atta Halilintar 38m Instagram, Deddy Corbuzier 24m -- while no published data exists on what any Indonesian creator below that tier earns.
stance_target: The claim that Southeast Asian creator evidence documents only the extreme top of the distribution, leaving the median and lower tiers entirely unmeasured
scope_conditions: Indonesia, follower counts as reported October 2025; follower counts are platform-reported and not audited; no earnings data accompanies any of these figures
quoted_support: Willie Salim is an influencer who is known for his creative short videos, comedy skits, and high engagement on TikTok where he has over 70m followers.
